title: Kronus Source
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

-- Create main UI window
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Kronus | Legends of Speed | Free",
    Icon = nil,
    LoadingTitle = "Kronus Loader",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Initializing...",
})

-- Create tabs
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Autofarms", nil)
local FastTab = Window:CreateTab("Fast Farms", nil)

-- Sections
MainTab:CreateSection("Standard Farms")
FastTab:CreateSection("Accelerated Farms")

-- Shared variables
local orbEvent = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("rEvents"):WaitForChild("orbEvent")

-- === Autofarm Orbs ===
local orbFarmEnabled = false
MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Autofarm Orbs",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        orbFarmEnabled = value
    end,
})

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if orbFarmEnabled then
            orbEvent:FireServer("collectOrb", "Orange Orb", "City")
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end)

-- === Autofarm Gems ===
local gemFarmEnabled = false

local function farmGems()
    while gemFarmEnabled do
        orbEvent:FireServer("collectOrb", "Gem", "City")
        task.wait()
    end
end

MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Autofarm Gems",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        gemFarmEnabled = value
        if gemFarmEnabled then
            task.spawn(farmGems)
        end
    end,
})

-- === Autofarm Hoops ===
local hoopFarmEnabled = false

local function farmHoops()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    while hoopFarmEnabled do
        for _, hoop in ipairs(workspace:WaitForChild("Hoops"):GetDescendants()) do
            if hoop:IsA("BasePart") and hoop.Name == "Hoop" then
                firetouchinterest(root, hoop, 0)
                task.wait()
                firetouchinterest(root, hoop, 1)
            end
        end
        task.wait()
    end
end

MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Autofarm Hoops",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(value)
        hoopFarmEnabled = value
        if value then
            task.spawn(farmHoops)
        end
    end,
})

-- === Fast Autofarms ===
local fastOrbEnabled, fastOrbThread
FastTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Fast Autofarm Orbs",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        fastOrbEnabled = state

        if state and not fastOrbThread then
            fastOrbThread = task.spawn(function()
                while fastOrbEnabled do
                    for _ = 1, 500000 do
                        orbEvent:FireServer("collectOrb", "Orange Orb", "City")
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                fastOrbThread = nil
            end)
        end
    end,
})

local fastGemEnabled, fastGemThread
FastTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Fast Autofarm Gems",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        fastGemEnabled = state

        if state and not fastGemThread then
            fastGemThread = task.spawn(function()
                while fastGemEnabled do
                    for _ = 1, 20 do
                        orbEvent:FireServer("collectOrb", "Gem", "City")
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                fastGemThread = nil
            end)
        end
    end,
})

local fastHoopEnabled, fastHoopThread
FastTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Fast Autofarm Hoops",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        fastHoopEnabled = state

        if state and not fastHoopThread then
            fastHoopThread = task.spawn(function()
                local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
                local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
                local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                while fastHoopEnabled do
                    for _, hoop in ipairs(workspace:WaitForChild("Hoops"):GetDescendants()) do
                        if hoop:IsA("BasePart") and hoop.Name == "Hoop" then
                            for _ = 1, 20 do
                                firetouchinterest(root, hoop, 0)
                                firetouchinterest(root, hoop, 1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                fastHoopThread = nil
            end)
        end
    end,
})

-- Notices
MainTab:CreateParagraph({
    Title = "Note",
    Content = "Auto Hoops work, but they have a built-in cooldown.",
})

FastTab:CreateParagraph({
    Title = "Warning",
    Content = "These farms are significantly faster and may cause lag or instability. Use with caution pls",
})
